newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Walbrzych to issue PLN 20 mln munibonds.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Walbrzych to issue PLN 20 mln munibonds.

text.p: The southwestern Polish city of Walbrzych plans to issue 20 million zlotys of three-year index-linked bonds in the first quarter of 1997, the city's treasurer, Alina Sawczak told Reuters on Friday.

She said that annual coupon of the bonds would be calculated as the average yield of Polish 52-week T-bills from the four primary auctions preceding the interest period, plus a margin of up to 125 basis points.
Funds raised from the issue, whose agent is to be chosen at the tender, would finance public transport purchases.
